boundary: These are symmetry-restricted upper-bound witnesses. A counterexample falsifies the global law, but the smallest sampled r is not a theorem about the minimum defect required. tau_2 remains in [111,115].
reading: A nonconcurrent repeated centre fibre is a decisive counterexample to the previously sampled global concurrency law. Its F+D=4r value is the exact defect budget of that witness, not a lower bound on the cost of nonconcurrency. The r=1 clean-core theorem after deleting dirty pencils is a different statement and is not contradicted by a high-defect witness.
